manifest.name: Wyoming TTS
manifest.description: Connect Wyoming protocol TTS servers to Music Assistant for text-to-speech.

user.title: Connect to the Wyoming TTS server
user.description: Enter the address of the Wyoming TTS server. Before the provider is added, the server is verified by discovering the voices it advertises.

server_uri.label: Server address
server_uri.description: The address of the Wyoming TTS server: tcp://host:port (a bare host:port is taken to be tcp).

voices.label: Voice filter
voices.description: Limit which of the server's voices are exposed as engines; empty exposes all of them. A value with a colon is a program pattern and a voice pattern, such as piper:en_US-*; a value equal to a program name selects all of its voices, such as piper; any other value is a voice name pattern across all programs, such as nl_NL-*. Patterns use * wildcards: bf matches only a voice named exactly bf, use *bf* to match names containing it.

voice_languages.label: Voice languages
voice_languages.description: Limit which of the server's voices are exposed by the languages they speak; empty exposes all of them. Each value is a glob pattern matched against the voice's language codes: en matches the code en exactly, en-* matches en and any of its variants such as en_GB.

output_format.label: Output format
output_format.description: The format rendered clips are stored and served in. MP3 is small and widely supported; WAV is plain PCM in a RIFF container and needs no encoder; Raw PCM is the server's unmodified output, served as audio/L16 with its sample rate in the content type, for players or endpoints that can consume headerless PCM.

synthesis_timeout.label: Synthesis timeout
synthesis_timeout.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the server to render a message. The first request on many servers loads the model and can be slow.

errors.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Wyoming server. Please check the address and that the server is running.
errors.no_tts_programs: The Wyoming server does not advertise any TTS voices. Please check its configuration.
errors.no_voices: The Wyoming server exposes no voice matching the configured filters. Change or clear the voice or language filters in the provider's options.
errors.voice_not_found: The configured TTS engine is no longer available on the Wyoming server. Re-pick an engine where the TTS engine is configured.
errors.synthesis_timeout: The Wyoming server did not render the message within {0} seconds. If it is still loading the model, raise the synthesis timeout in the provider's options.
